choices.question: What's your exact laptop model and year? (so ports and display limits can be checked before buying)
What is the screen mainly for? (asked once; otherwise stated as an assumption or used to steer picks)
options: chat, email, or video / reference material

choices.question: Does your laptop's USB-C port support video output? (check before ordering)
options: HDMI for video plus separate power connection

choices.question: Freestanding portable monitor or an extender that attaches to the laptop lid?
options: freestanding portable monitor (easier to position, doesn't load the hinge, not tied to lid size)
attached extender (tight spaces / narrow tables, screens move as one unit and stay aligned)

choices.question: Do you need touch (or does bag space matter)? (mostly stated as an assumption of no touch)
options: touch or bag space matters (worth the premium)

choices.question: Is the extra cost comfortable, or is price secondary?
options: extra cost is comfortable / price is secondary

choices.question: Do you want one added screen or two? (check the laptop's external-display limit, particularly on a Mac, and whether the extender needs a driver)
For an attached extender: do your lid dimensions, mounting fit and hinge stability suit it?
options: check lid dimensions and hinge stability before buying

split_by: resolution: 2560 × 1600 / 2560 × 1440 (sharper text, more workspace for documents, coding, spreadsheets), 2240 × 1400 (sharper text and more vertical room on a 14-inch), 1080p (cheaper; chat, email, reference documents, video; text less crisp), 4K OLED (best image quality, photography or video)
refresh rate: 180Hz (work and gaming), 144Hz (smoother games on a budget)

screen size: 13.3-inch (attached slide-out for a roughly 13–14-inch laptop), 14-inch (compact, travel, bag space, smaller laptop), 15.6–16.1-inch (roomy work screen, larger-screen choice when you have table space)
aspect ratio: 16:10 (taller, vertical space for documents and coding)
touch: touchscreen (worth the premium if touch matters; compact/travel picks), no touch (assumed default, value)

price: under $100 (best under $100), about $105–$133 (value / best overall value), about $165–$252 (value and premium work picks), about $312 (compact touchscreen), $499.99 (image quality, expensive for office work)
mounting: freestanding with kickstand/stand (flexible positioning), attached slide-out extender (tight spaces, screens move together)
inputs: USB-C plus mini-HDMI (HDMI video needs separate power), USB-C only (noted as a limitation)
independent testing: tested overall winner (WIRED, Tom's Hardware), picked on specs and price only (value picks, not independently verified)
weight: about 1.3 lb, 1.64–1.7 lb (portability), 2.8 lb with stand (drawback)
